name: FLArE
summary: FLArE is a proposed modular liquid-argon TPC in the Forward Physics Facility at CERN. It would measure the intense forward flux of high-energy collider neutrinos and search for scattering of light dark-sector particles.
physics_targets: Electron-, muon- and tau-neutrino interactions at high energies
Light dark-matter scattering and other new physics
detection_principle: Ionization imaging and scintillation-light timing reconstruct interactions in liquid argon. Fine spatial sampling distinguishes particle tracks and electromagnetic showers; downstream hadron and muon measurement improves containment, flavour identification and background rejection.

sites.name: Proposed Forward Physics Facility cavern
sites.location: CERN land west of the ATLAS interaction point

status.label: Proposed
status.evidence: The official FPF project description states that the detector is under development by physics and technical working groups. It does not establish a completed FLArE detector or neutrino exposure.

timeline.event: Named FLArE detector concept studied for far-forward dark-matter scattering.
Included in the comprehensive FPF physics and detector report.

collaboration.name: FLArE physics and technical working groups
collaboration.participants_note: Institutions listed here are selected documented participants; the official collaboration page provides the complete membership.

key_parameters.name: Proposed facility geometry
key_parameters.value: Cavern spanning approximately 617-682 m west of ATLAS, on the French side of the border

key_parameters.name: Readout concept
key_parameters.value: Modular liquid-argon TPC with downstream hadron and muon measurement

key_parameters.name: Particle-energy reconstruction goal
key_parameters.value: Approximately 10 MeV to many hundreds of GeV; this describes detector dynamic range, not a dark-matter mass interval

key_parameters.name: Neutrino programme
key_parameters.value: High-energy and TeV-scale collider neutrinos; simulated event yields depend on luminosity, target mass and forward-production modelling

results.summary: Published detector concepts and projected neutrino and new-physics capabilities. The quoted yields and sensitivity forecasts are not measured FLArE results.

science_scope: FLArE is a proposed experiment within the proposed FPF facility. The FPF is the host facility rather than another detector; FASERnu2, FASER2 and FORMOSA are different detector concepts.
